import MumfordLib.AffineSimplexChainMaps
import MumfordLib.SingularAffineSimplexGeometry

/-!
# Evaluating affine chains along singular simplices

A continuous map from a standard simplex sends ordered affine vertex chains
to singular chains. Evaluation commutes with affine reparametrization. These
identities transfer barycentric subdivision of standard simplices to arbitrary
singular chains.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {X Y : TopCat} {m k n : ℕ}

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem singularSimplexChain_map (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (σ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).obj (op ⦋n⦌)) :
    singularSimplexChain σ ≫
        (SSet.chainComplexMap (TopCat.toSSet.map f) (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).f n =
      singularSimplexChain ((TopCat.toSSet.map f).app _ σ) :=
  SSet.ι_chainComplexMap_f _ _ _ _ _

/-- Send affine chains in a standard simplex along a continuous map. -/
def affineSingularEvaluation (f : C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)), X)) :
    VertexListChainComplex (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) ⟶
      IntegralSingularChainComplex X :=
  affineVertexListChainMap m ≫
    SSet.chainComplexMap (TopCat.toSSet.map (Y := X) (TopCat.ofHom f))
      (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem vertexListChain_affineSingularEvaluation
    (f : C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)), X))
    (v : Fin (n + 1) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) :
    vertexListChain v ≫ (affineSingularEvaluation f).f n =
      singularSimplexChain ((X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋n⦌)).symm
        (f.comp (affineSimplexMap v))) := by
  exact (vertexListChain_affineVertexListChainMap_assoc v _).trans
    (SSet.ι_chainComplexMap_f _ _ _ _ _)

/-- Evaluation along a composite affine parametrization agrees with mapping
the vertices first. -/
theorem affineSingularEvaluation_naturality
    (f : C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 1)), X))
    (w : Fin (m + 1) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 1))) :
    vertexListChainMap (affineSimplexMap w) ≫ affineSingularEvaluation f =
      affineSingularEvaluation (f.comp (affineSimplexMap w)) := by
  ext n : 1
  apply SSet.chainComplex_hom_ext
  intro v
  change vertexListChain v ≫ _ = vertexListChain v ≫ _
  simp only [HomologicalComplex.comp_f, vertexListChain_map_assoc,
    vertexListChain_affineSingularEvaluation]
  congr 2
  ext t
  exact congrArg f (affineSimplexMap_comp v w t).symm

/-- The standard ordered vertices recover the original singular simplex. -/
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem vertexListChain_vertices_affineSingularEvaluation
    (f : C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)), X)) :
    vertexListChain stdSimplex.vertex ≫ (affineSingularEvaluation f).f m =
      singularSimplexChain ((X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋m⦌)).symm f) := by
  rw [vertexListChain_affineSingularEvaluation]
  congr 2
  ext t
  exact congrArg f (affineSimplexMap_vertex_id t)

/-- The affine map determined by standard vertices is coordinate reindexing. -/
theorem affineSimplexMap_vertices_comp (a : Fin (m + 1) → Fin (k + 1))
    (t : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) :
    affineSimplexMap (stdSimplex.vertex ∘ a) t = stdSimplex.map a t := by
  rw [← affineSimplexMap_map, affineSimplexMap_vertex_id]

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem vertexListChain_vertices_map
    (w : Fin (m + 1) → stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (k + 1))) :
    vertexListChain stdSimplex.vertex ≫
        (vertexListChainMap (affineSimplexMap w)).f m = vertexListChain w := by
  rw [vertexListChain_map]
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact affineSimplexMap_vertex w i

/-- Evaluation along a face is evaluation in the larger simplex after the
corresponding affine map of vertices. -/
theorem affineSingularEvaluation_face
    (σ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).obj (op ⦋m + 1⦌)) (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    affineSingularEvaluation (X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋m⦌)
      ((TopCat.toSSet.obj X).δ i σ)) =
      vertexListChainMap (affineSimplexMap (stdSimplex.vertex ∘ i.succAbove)) ≫
        affineSingularEvaluation (X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋m + 1⦌) σ) := by
  rw [affineSingularEvaluation_naturality]
  congr 1
  ext t
  change X.toSSetObjEquiv (op ⦋m + 1⦌) σ (stdSimplex.map i.succAbove t) = _
  rw [ContinuousMap.comp_apply, affineSimplexMap_vertices_comp]

/-- Evaluation is natural in the target topological space. -/
theorem affineSingularEvaluation_postcomp
    (f : C(stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (m + 1)), X)) (g : X ⟶ Y) :
    affineSingularEvaluation f ≫
        SSet.chainComplexMap (TopCat.toSSet.map g) (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ) =
      affineSingularEvaluation (g.hom.comp f) := by
  unfold affineSingularEvaluation
  rw [Category.assoc]
  apply congrArg (fun h => affineVertexListChainMap m ≫ h)
  exact (((SSet.chainComplexFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).map_comp
    (TopCat.toSSet.map (Y := X) (TopCat.ofHom f)) (TopCat.toSSet.map g)).symm.trans
      (congrArg (((SSet.chainComplexFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ)).obj (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)).map)
        (TopCat.toSSet.map_comp (TopCat.ofHom f : _ ⟶ X) g).symm)

end Mumford.Analytic
